evidence_scope: C5G7 is a computational transport benchmark, not an experiment. Numerical agreement is benchmark verification, not physical validation of unmeasured layouts.

claim_ladder.L2: Numerical verification against canonical C5G7 UMMU reference only; requires B1, B2 and B4
claim_ladder.L3: Layout ordering reproducibility and symmetry; requires L2, B3 and B5
claim_ladder.L4: CB-PFR selection-effect evaluation on physical candidate simulations; requires L3, B6 and B7; negative outcomes must be reported
claim_ladder.L5: Experimental toolchain validation only; B8 does not validate layout ranking

upstream.required_zero_warning: Fission source site(s) outside of entropy box

physical_objective.name: minimize_assembly_integrated_fission_rate_peaking_factor
physical_objective.R_a: sum of mesh fission-score means over the 17x17 bin block mapped to fuel assembly a
physical_objective.keff_role: report and verify k-effective separately; do not use the canonical UMMU reference as a hard acceptance band for noncanonical layouts without independent domain sign-off
physical_objective.hard_design_feasibility_threshold: NOT_SET_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_DOMAIN_SIGNOFF; B7 cannot claim physical feasibility beyond the fixed material-count/geometry constraints until this is resolved

B1.purpose: pilot only; choose inactive batch count and determine whether 7000 total batches is adequate

source_initialization.pairing: same seed across the four source-start profiles
source_initialization.note: source profiles use initial source sampling boxes restricted to fissionable material; they do not restrict subsequent eigenvalue transport

inactive_sweep.pairing: same seed across all four inactive-batch conditions

gates.integrity: 24/24 completed with raw HDF5 audit pass, standard energy groups, unique statepoint hashes, seed/settings correspondence, entropy trace, k-generation trace, and zero entropy-mesh warnings
gates.inactive_choice: smallest inactive count for which all 3 replicate traces satisfy both drift criteria
gates.source_start_equivalence: For each alternative vs baseline, paired 90% Student-t CI (df=2) for mean delta k-effective must lie entirely inside [-25,+25] pcm
gates.chosen_profile_confirmation: If selected inactive count differs from 500, repeat all four source profiles at that inactive count with three fresh paired seeds before B1 passes
gates.fail_action: If no inactive profile passes, source-start equivalence fails, or 7000-batch drift screen is inadequate, B1 is inconclusive; run a versioned higher-batch pilot and do not start B2

B2.gate_rule: B1 must pass first. Keep B2 seeds distinct from B1 and all pre-correction runs.

B4.requirement: reviewed official pin-power reference table, verified 51x51-to-pin mapping and normalization, AVG/RMS/MAX relative errors and uncertainty

B3.rule: 90% CI of each preregistered pairwise mean-k difference must lie wholly within ±12 pcm; otherwise report not equivalent/inconclusive

B5.requirement: independent second transport code, matched model/material/nuclear-data definitions, compatible tallies, reported k-effective differences and ordering; block if code or matched 7-group data unavailable

B6.geometry: 5x5 assembly lattice with fixed outer reflector row/column and 3x3 fuel interior
B6.symmetry: recompute equivalence classes under actual boundary-condition-preserving transformations; 23 applies only under full D4 symmetry
B6.gate: only use 7000 batches if a new-geometry pilot has passed; otherwise amend and raise budget

B7.endpoint: probability of selecting the best layout under the registered F_fission objective and regret F, with paired pool-level bootstrap intervals
B7.equal_budget: must be genuinely equal across methods; 690 physical runs total cannot independently fund 690 runs per each of six policies
B7.smoke_profile_warning: may carry source-convergence bias and may not define physical truth or validated uncertainty

options: audit BEAVRS registration/orientation against measured geometry
B8.rule: does not validate unmeasured six-layout ranking

no_result_rules: No downstream block starts before its explicit gate passes.
No rerun because a result is unfavorable; only documented infrastructure failure, integrity mismatch, or preregistered extension is eligible.
Failed jobs, exclusions, inconclusive tests, and negative comparisons remain reportable.
No official benchmark acceptance, experimental ranking validation, reactor safety, quantum advantage, or CB-PFR physical superiority claim is authorized by this protocol.
